All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Critical / high priority**
- **LOL-CAP (deviation)** — Section 15 excludes consequential damages mutually but sets no aggregate cap; we added a mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M) with Excluded Claims outside it.
- **INDEMN (deviation)** — IP indemnity exists and sits outside Section 15, but is limited to breach of the ownership warranty; added breach-of-law, data-compromise and gross negligence/wilful misconduct heads plus a material-prejudice notice qualifier.
- **IP (deviation)** — Garman owns the Modifications we pay for and our data ownership is unaddressed; added data ownership, licence-back to funded Modifications, no joint ownership.
- **ASSIGN (deviation)** — absolute consent bar; added affiliate/successor carve-out and reasonableness standard (Sections 20(d) and 3(c)).
- **LICENSE (deviation)** — non-transferable, contractors excluded; extended to contractors, made irrevocable and successor-transferable.
- **T4C (deviation)** — 90-day convenience right with no refund; shortened to 30 days plus prepaid-fee refund (Garman has no convenience right — retained).
- **NOSOLICIT (deviation)** — mutual no-hire of all employees; narrowed to a non-solicit of engaged personnel with advertising carve-outs.

**Medium / low**
- **GOVLAW (deviation)** — Nova Scotia replaced with New York law and courts.
- **RENEWAL (deviation)** — undefined "renewable" maintenance term; added 12-month renewals, 30-day opt-out, uplift cap.
- **WARRANTY (deviation)** — good 12-month conformance warranty, but no remedy or services warranty; added both.
- **INSURANCE (missing)** and **TRANSITION (missing)** — inserted standard clauses.
- **Compliant, no redline:** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, AUDIT, LD, MINCOMMIT (subject to confirming Schedule "A" holds no committed spend, as Schedules were not attached).
